data.summary: Editor plan written (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-visual-editor.md) and milestone 1 built on branch visual-editor-m1: internal/store (load with token, save if unchanged, Committed content from HEAD) and internal/tomledit (span writer; Format re-lays out spans but keeps each value's text as written). A formatter built on Format would not normalise value text such as hand-aligned decision-table cells unless it adds that; row-level diffs and change-to-work can read committed content through store.Committed.
